# BTicino C300X Integration v2.8.3

## Unreleased

[![Support me on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/oliver7557)

## Saving camera quality

Selecting **960x576** now accepts an existing backup directory owned by the
manufacturer user. Its ownership is left unchanged, and the complete original
file is preserved for restoring an original size or removing the agent. This
requires the device-agent update.

## Camera controls

Unavailable cameras no longer accept stream or microphone starts. If the camera
disappears or a Ring Call ends while an answer or microphone request is pending,
the card discards that request and releases any microphone tracks that arrive
late. A newer session is left alone.

## Talkback and routing

- UDP talkback requires a live, playing RTSP peer. Unsolicited packets and packets
  from closed or parked sessions are discarded. This is a trusted-LAN safeguard,
  not encryption or cryptographic authentication of UDP media.
- Applying a routing patch verifies the complete supported firmware image before
  changing it or its recovery copy.
- Media-user setup leaves unrecognized active routing files untouched and reports
  them as unsupported. Readiness respects both supported internal routing and
  smartphone forwarding.

These changes require the packaged device-agent update, not only the HA update.

## Settings

Camera quality descriptions are shorter. Saving changed values still restarts
the device. Picture sizes come from the installed device agent: update that agent
and reopen the options to see newly supported sizes.

This maintenance version does not add C100X support or firmware-3.0.6 beta display
features.
